factoryData.readme:
# Code library

Reusable Swift / Python code, packaged as **blocks** — one code unit per folder under `blocks/`,
each self-describing (`block.json`), offline-tested, and MCP-ready. The full standard is in
[`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md); `blocks/_template/` is the reference block to copy.

**Rule:** if a sprint writes something twice, it becomes a block. New code is authored directly as
a block; the discovery view is `catalog.json`.

## Blocks (`blocks/`)
- `color-matching/` — seasonal color analysis (Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter → palette + avoid) + color-wheel harmonies. Python.
- `color-extraction/` — an image's dominant colors with coverage %. Python.
- `vision-camera/` — on-device capture + CryptoKit image encryption. Swift.
- `ux-position-mask/` — flag which screen elements sit in good/dangerous positions (thumb reach, active zones, safe areas). Python.
- `ux-attention-pattern/` — classify a screen's reading flow (F / Z / focused / scattered) from its attention map and judge it. Python (uses the saliency attention modules).

## Local UIs / tools (not blocks)
Small web UIs used to exercise blocks during development — no `block.json`, not MCP seams, some
gitignored (local-only): `color-test-ui/`, `wireframe-studio/`, `face-parsing-ui/`, `vinet-ui/`.

## Test
```
cd blocks && pytest        # all code blocks, offline
```
